purpose: Implement the FT-001 local session lifecycle and the internal activation handoff primitive needed by FT-003.
success_outcome: Local credentials and sessions can be issued, validated, revoked, and fail-closed against Account and FarmMembership status.
anti_goals: No hosted recovery or email delivery.

forbidden_scope: FT-003 public local invite activation route

commands: Check changed code preserves linked Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, Foundation Smoke API when relevant, and Evidence Redaction contracts or records a blocker.
Check session lifecycle tests prove created_at plus 7-day expires_at calculation, current-session-only logout revocation, and no revival of expired/revoked sessions.
Check session verification tests use token_hash lookup and the TASK-006 constant-time digest comparison primitive for valid, malformed, unknown, revoked, and expired tokens.
Check session repositories/services use the Foundation Data Substrate session boundary and preserve the FT-001 session lifecycle.
success_checks: Login creates a new LocalSession and does not revive expired or revoked sessions.
Session issuance uses the TASK-006 primitive: raw token returned once through transport, only SHA-256 token_hash persisted, and default expires_at is created_at plus 7 days.
Presented session tokens are verified by computing token_hash and using the TASK-006 constant-time digest comparison path.
Logout revokes only the current session and invalid/missing logout can be idempotent.
Session validity is fail-closed from session, Account, and FarmMembership status.
Internal activation primitive activates Account/FarmMembership and issues a session only after FT-003 validates invite credentials.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.
evidence_required: session issuance evidence showing 7-day expires_at and token_hash-only persistence
session verification evidence showing malformed/unknown/revoked/expired tokens fail closed through token_hash lookup
internal activation primitive evidence without public FT-003 route implementation

stop_conditions: Session lifecycle cannot be proven fail-closed.
Session service reimplements or diverges from the TASK-006 credential/session primitive contract.
Implementation requires public FT-003 route ownership.
Raw auth material would enter persistence, logs, or evidence.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
